To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
authentic leadership has a significant impact on employee commitment to change in public sector hospitals undergoing restructuring.

Authentic leadership is positively related with commitment to change, and cynicism about change moderates this positive relationship such as that a high level level of authentic leadership is associated with a higher level of commitment to change when the level of cynicism is low, rather than when cynism about change is high.
authentic leadership is a positive predictor of commitment to change in the context of public sector hospital restructuring.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of authentic leadership in the public sector hospital context and how it influences cynicism about change and commitment to change.
the moderating role that cynicism about organizational changes plays between authentic leadership and the employees’ commitment to change in public hospitals in Pakistan.
the role of cynicism as an antecedent of commitment to change in the context of public sector privatization in Pakistan.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
authentic leadership is more effective in enhancing commitment to change when followers are not cynical.

this study has shown that authentic leadership has a positive relationship with commitment to change and that this positive relationship is moderated by cynicism about change such that authentic leadership is a more potent antecedent to commitment to change when followers are less cynical about change rather than when they are cynical.
authentic leadership has a positive impact on commitment to the change when cynicism about change is low rather than high.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
authentic leadership can be used to mitigate cynicism and enhance commitment to change.
cynicism is a negative emotion which can be mitigated by authenticity in leadership.
authentic leadership is more effective when cynicism is lower, and cynicism about change is more detrimental when authentic leadership is lower.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cynicism about change is not an insurmountable barrier to successful organizational change and that authenticity is one way to overcome it.
authentic leaders can mitigate cynicism and enhance commitment to change, which can facilitate organizational change.
authentic leadership may be an important tool for leaders in Pakistan to enhance commitment to organizational change.
